purpose: Teach: 魔王/アーケード/パイプライン/抗体/動植物/音階/鷲/製鉄

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが魔王のキャラのおもちゃくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father gave you that demon king toy, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, conversational observation. Slight lilt at the end, inviting acknowledgment. Gentle attention, the cadence of noticing and remarking what her son might not have mentioned yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、商店街のアーケードでアイスクリーム食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I ate ice cream at the shopping arcade today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate eagerness. Quick attack on the opening. Slightly breathless with the news—wanting to share something good that happened. Guileless and warm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがパイプライン工事のお仕事してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been working on the pipeline construction job, you know.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. The tone of passing along information she's gathered. Slight warmth underneath—seeing if he knows or wants to know about his father's day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、抗体検査ってちょっと怖いよ
lines.en: Mom, the antibody test was kind of scary.
lines.style: Soft, hesitant entry. Vulnerability just underneath. Speaking carefully, as if testing whether it's safe to admit worry. Trailing uncertainty at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが動植物図鑑くださったわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather has that eagle sculpture, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. A gentle observation about something in the family's world. Noticing and mentioning what her son might find interesting. Relaxed rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノの音階の練習頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I worked really hard on my piano scales today.
lines.style: Proud but not boastful. Bright, steady rhythm. The quiet confidence of a child who did something difficult and wants to share it. Open, expecting warmth in return.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが鷲の彫刻を持ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather has that eagle sculpture he keeps.
lines.style: Warm, reflective observation. Noticing something in the family world. Gentle, conversational rhythm. The cadence of mentioning something that connects him to the people he cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんから製鉄所のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me about the steel mill.
lines.style: Eager, focused warmth. Quick entry. The excitement of having been included in something grown-up—a story from his father. Eyes bright, wanting to be heard.
